agreement_student_levels.notes: Blank in partner Excel agreement list; ICN 2025-26 fact sheet covers Bachelor in Management (Y2-Y3) and Master/MSc programmes.

min_standing_note.value: Maximum age limit: 25 years old. Prerequisite prior studies by level: Bachelor Y2 requires min 1 yr (60 ECTS); Bachelor Y3 requires min 2 yrs (120 ECTS); Pre-Master / MSc 1 requires min 3 yrs (180 ECTS); Master 2 / MSc 2 requires min 4 yrs (240 ECTS).
min_standing_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=4
min_standing_note.notes: Master/MSc prior credit requirements detailed on p.5-7.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement scope states 'Business Administration' field rather than an AUC school code.

instruction_languages.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=8
instruction_languages.notes: Programmes offered in English or French across Nancy, Paris, and Berlin campuses (bilingual tracks require both).

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=4
english_course_availability.notes: Full English-track specializations offered at Bachelor and Master/MSc levels (p.4-7).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2 required for English-taught tracks: TOEFL 80, IELTS 6.5, TOEIC 750, Cambridge C, Duolingo 110, OR a home-university certificate confirming completion of or current study in an English-taught degree programme (RHET 1020 policy not explicitly named; AUC instruction is in English).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=8

host_language_requirement.value: French CEFR B2 attestation from home university required only for French-taught or bilingual tracks; English-only tracks do not require French.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=8

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-27 web update & 2025-26 calendar: Fall semester runs late August/early September to mid/late December; mandatory online info session Jul 20, 2026; mandatory orientation Sep 4, 2026 (Nancy/Paris) and Sep 14-16, 2026 (Berlin).
fall_term_dates.notes: Verified against 2025-26 calendar structure in ICN Fact Sheet p.2.

spring_term_dates.value: 2026-27 web update & 2025-26 calendar: Spring semester runs early January to mid/late May; mandatory online info session Dec 16, 2026; mandatory orientation Jan 8-9, 2027 (Nancy/Paris) and early Jan 2027 (Berlin).
spring_term_dates.notes: Verified against 2025-26 calendar structure in ICN Fact Sheet p.2.

tuition_model.notes: Official ICN exchange portal states tuition fees at ICN are waived for incoming exchange students under partner agreements.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=9
est_monthly_living_local.notes: 2025-26 Fact Sheet p.9 lists primary city Nancy cost of living: 400 to 1,000 EUR/month (private student residences 400-500 EUR/mo, state residences 150-535 EUR/mo). Also lists Paris: 900-1,300 EUR/month and Berlin: 800-1,000 EUR/month.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=9
living_cost_usd_est.notes: Nancy primary campus midpoint EUR 700.00/month (400-1,000 EUR/mo) * 5 months = EUR 3,500.00; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 3,868.20 USD (Paris/Berlin costs higher).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition fees waived under exchange agreement; approx. EUR 40 library fee applies (p.9). Health insurance is mandatory: EU students use EHIC; non-EU students in France enroll in free French Social Security upon registration (etudiant-etranger.ameli.fr) while Germany campus students require Sozialversicherungsausweis / valid German student insurance.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=9

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=9
housing_availability.notes: Housing intern assists Apr-Sep (housing-info@icn-artem.com) alongside LivinFrance / Studapart / VISALE platforms; state-owned residences ~150-535 EUR/mo and private residences ~400-500 EUR/mo.

housing_notes.value: State-owned university residences ~150-535 EUR/mo; furnished studios in private residences ~400-500 EUR/mo. Support via LivinFrance platform and seasonal housing intern (Apr-Sep: housing-info@icn-artem.com).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=9

citizenship_restrictions.notes: Note age ceiling in Fact Sheet p.4: maximum age limit for incoming exchange applicants is 25 years old.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: For France, ICN adheres to the CEF (Etudes en France / Campus France) visa convention; LivinFrance platform provides step-by-step French/German visa support.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=8
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: LivinFrance visa assistance described on p.9.

course_catalog_url.notes: Fixed specialization tracks by campus (Nancy/Paris/Berlin) detailed in 2025-26 Fact Sheet p.4-7.

credit_system_and_load.notes: ECTS system (prior-study credit prerequisites 60/120/180/240 ECTS on p.4-7; explicit per-semester exchange credit minimum/maximum not stated in ICN 2025-26 Fact Sheet).

course_restrictions_note.value: Courses cannot be mixed across different programmes or academic levels due to timetable constraints; MSc 2 / Master 2 accepts Fall semester exchange students only; bilingual tracks require both French and English B2 proficiency; max age 25.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=6
course_restrictions_note.notes: Fixed-program policy verified on icn-artem.com; MSc 2 Fall-only on p.6-7.

value: Copy of passport or identity card
CV (in French or English depending on track)
Letter of motivation (in French or English depending on track)
English test/degree-in-English certificate (for English tracks) or French B2 attestation (for French tracks)
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=8

academic_style.value: Triple-accredited (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA) French business school built on interdisciplinary ARTEM pillars connecting Management, Technology, and Art.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=2

campus_type.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=2
campus_type.notes: Three campuses in Nancy (ARTEM campus), Paris, and Berlin.

international_support_services.value: ICN International Relations Office (icnexchange@icn-artem.com), mandatory online info sessions, campus orientation days (plus optional French Alps seminar for English Bachelor track), LivinFrance onboarding platform, and seasonal housing intern.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ICN Business School/2025-2026/ICN Business School Fact Sheet - Exchange Students - 2025-2026.pdf#page=2
international_support_services.notes: Orientation, LivinFrance, and housing intern details on p.2, 8-9.

nomination_deadlines.value: 2026-27 deadlines: Fall semester / Full year May 15; Spring semester October 15.
nomination_deadlines.notes: Matches 15 May / 15 October dates in 2025-26 Fact Sheet p.2.
